meaning: A plotting convention: model M1 is drawn first as a thick blue backdrop (5.0 pt), model M3 second as a thin fluorescent orange line (2.0 pt) on top. It fixes which curve reads as the reference in every figure from this script.

could_move.what: Colour and linewidth constants for the two model traces; swapping the values would reverse which model looks like the reference
LW_M1 = 5.0 vs LW_M3 = 2.0 — the thickness contrast that carries the backdrop/overlay reading
The comment claims MODELS lists M1 first, so draw order follows list order; if that list is reordered, orange would be hidden under blue
C_REF is a third colour not covered by the stated rule, so its role in the same figures is unclear from this context

expectation: Figure appearance only: no effect on fitted parameters or solver output. Whether the claim about MODELS ordering still holds cannot be checked from this context — the reach trace found no references and no models, so I cannot confirm the constants are actually consumed in the stated order.

check.why: Re-runs only the plotting script (no re-fit) so a human can look at the output figures and confirm blue M1 is the thick backdrop and orange M3 sits on top.
